tool_map.name: Marks at the Gate
tool_map.objective: Students mark each cow that leaves, strike out one mark for each that returns, and tell if any cow is missing.
tool_map.purpose: Students make one mark for each cow that leaves and strike out one mark for each cow that returns. Include the textbook question: "Did all the cows come back home?"

tool_map.name: Count the Big Herd
tool_map.objective: Students count 47 marks in groups of five and find how many cows are still out and how many came home.
tool_map.purpose: Use the exact textbook tally: nine groups of five and two extra marks = 47 cows. Students identify why Deba and Deep were worried, how many cows were still out (2), and how many reached home (45).

tool_map.name: Hemant's Cows and Sheep
tool_map.objective: Students make a separate row of marks for each kind of animal: 36 cows and 23 sheep.
tool_map.purpose: Students make separate tally records for 36 cows and 23 sheep. Do not combine the two totals.

tool_map.name: Longest and Shortest Names
tool_map.objective: Students count the letters in names to find the longest and the shortest name, and to see when two names are equally long.
tool_map.purpose: One focused activity with three short stages: animal team captains; compare Mahesh and Kartik; compare the names students enter for the friends' name activity. Cover the related textbook questions without adding new questions.

tool_map.name: Starting and Ending Letters
tool_map.objective: Students sort names by their starting and ending letters and count each group to find the most used starting letter.
tool_map.purpose: Students identify their own starting letter, sort the textbook name set by starting and ending letters, count matching names, find the most-used starting letter and identify letters not used at the start.

tool_map.name: Build a Number Name
tool_map.objective: Students build a number name from one or two number cards, tens card first, and count its letters.
tool_map.purpose: Cover the textbook examples 43 and 17, then let students use their own roll number. The notebook task to write more number names is shown as a short optional instruction card, not a separate tool.

tool_map.name: Number Name Puzzles
tool_map.objective: Students use the letter counts of number names to find the numbers between 1 and 99 that fit a clue.
tool_map.purpose: Cover the textbook tasks: numbers with eight letters, longest number names, the near-100 clue and the smallest name from 63 to 78. Accept all valid answers: 93, 97 and 98 for the near-100 clue; 70 for the 63 to 78 clue. Show a short instruction card for making a similar puzzle in the notebook.

tool_map.name: Group the Cards Two Ways
tool_map.objective: Students group things by a rule, find the rule behind a grouping, and regroup the same things by another rule.
tool_map.purpose: One tool focused on grouping by a rule, with three short stages: identify Jojo's rule (things that fly / do not fly); sort the eight household objects by electricity use; regroup the same eight objects using another valid rule. Accept multiple sensible groupings in the final stage.
